rows.text: 恩田後來回顧，公司在一九六六年就曾賣過生醬油。
rows.prompt: Medium shot in a plain kitchen, one anonymous adult setting an unmarked closed sauce container on a table, soft window light.

rows.text: 他說，當時很難維持鮮度；那次產品沒有普及，後來停止販售。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a simple workbench, one anonymous reader examining a closed plain sauce container beside an unlettered archive folder, gentle desk light.

rows.text: 可你隔幾天再拿起容器，閥擋住了空氣，就一定還倒得出來嗎？
rows.prompt: Medium close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous technician tilting an unmarked flexible pouch above a small empty dish, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 另一份公開專利裡，申請人記錄了五百毫升軟膜原型的試製和試驗。
rows.prompt: Wide shot at a simple laboratory bench, one anonymous researcher examining an unmarked soft film pouch beside a separate enlarged hinge model, soft neutral light.

rows.text: 他們先把橡膠小蓋與本體一體成形，再從內側加壓，把圓弧部分切開。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a model workbench, one anonymous technician examining a simple unlettered rubber flap model with a curved separated edge, gentle side light.

rows.text: 直線那一小段沒有切斷，成為小蓋翻動的鉸接處。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a model workbench, one anonymous technician lifting a simple rubber flap connected along one straight edge, soft desk light.

rows.text: 但一受撞擊，這扇小門會只往外翻，還是連整片都陷進去？
rows.prompt: Medium close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous researcher considering a hinged flap above a simple hollow tube model, soft side light.

rows.text: 文件先指出，小蓋可能被衝擊擠進筒內，連逆止與出液都受影響。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a model workbench, one anonymous technician holding a simple hollow tube model with its small flap displaced inward, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 它在小蓋側面加上凸部，讓凸部抵住開口邊緣，抑制往裡陷。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a model workbench, one anonymous technician showing a small side bump on a hinged rubber flap resting against a plain opening rim, mild side light.

rows.text: 做好的閥裝進軟膜容器，再灌入醬油，接著就要等下一次取用。
rows.prompt: Medium shot at a simple test bench, one anonymous technician filling an unmarked flexible pouch with dark condiment liquid, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 留在常溫幾個時段後，你想要的兩件事，還會一起成立嗎？
rows.prompt: Wide shot at a neutral testing shelf, one anonymous researcher arranging plain filled flexible pouch samples, soft ambient light.

rows.text: 每個時間條件都用五個樣品，先以目視判斷，有沒有空氣混進容器。
rows.prompt: Medium shot at a plain test bench, one anonymous technician observing five unmarked filled pouch specimens, mild overhead light.

rows.text: 再把容器傾到約四十五度，看醬油能不能順利流出。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous technician tilting an unmarked flexible pouch over a small dish, soft side light.

rows.text: 前兩天的幾個觀察點，全都未見空氣混入，出液也良好；等到五天呢？
rows.prompt: Medium close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous researcher setting a tilted plain pouch beside a small filled dish, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 一百二十小時後，仍未看見空氣混入；但容器傾斜，醬油不再自然流出。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a neutral test bench, one anonymous technician holding a tilted plain pouch above an empty dish, soft side light.

rows.text: 文件記下，閥蓋與開口邊緣接觸的地方，有少量醬油固化。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a model workbench, one anonymous technician inspecting a small dark deposit where a simple rubber flap meets its opening rim, soft desk light.

rows.text: 那若容器掉下去，外面沒有漏出醬油，小蓋就一定還在原位嗎？
rows.prompt: Medium shot at a plain testing area, one anonymous researcher examining an intact unmarked flexible pouch above a neutral surface, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 另一組落下試驗，不裝外蓋時，讓樣品底朝下，自然落下一次。
rows.prompt: Wide shot in a neutral testing area, one anonymous technician holding an uncapped plain film pouch with its bottom facing a plain test surface, soft ambient light.

rows.text: 裝了外蓋，程序改成先底朝下落一次，再讓側面朝下落一次。
rows.prompt: Medium shot in a neutral testing area, one anonymous technician positioning a capped plain film pouch sideways above a plain test surface, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 每個條件各用五個樣品，落下後，再看空氣與出液這兩項結果。
rows.prompt: Wide shot at a plain test bench, one anonymous researcher examining five unmarked flexible pouch samples beside small sauce dishes, mild neutral light.

rows.text: 表列一百四十公分那組，兩項觀察還都正常；再抬高呢？
rows.prompt: Medium close-up in a neutral testing area, one anonymous technician raising a plain flexible pouch above an unlettered test surface, soft side light.

rows.text: 一百六十公分那組，小蓋陷進筒內，空氣混入，醬油也不能自然倒出。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous technician holding a simplified pouch neck model with its small hinged flap displaced inward, gentle desk light.

rows.text: 可是直到這組高度的各次試驗，文件都沒有觀察到內容物漏到外面。
rows.prompt: Medium close-up at a plain test bench, one anonymous researcher examining the dry outside of an unmarked film pouch beside an empty dish, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 瓶子從你手裡放回餐桌，坐在它後面的人，還看得見嗎？
rows.prompt: Low angle across a small dining table, one anonymous adult placing a plain clear flexible sauce bottle beside a dish, soft daylight.

rows.text: 恩田說，現行主流瓶型要顧到握持的貼合，放桌上還要避免擋住孩子的視線。
rows.prompt: Medium close-up beside a dining table, one anonymous adult gripping a plain flexible bottle with a child's empty chair visible behind the table, soft window light.

rows.text: 如果你放開手，瓶身卻還凹著，問題只在手裡的力道嗎？
rows.prompt: Close-up beside a kitchen counter, one anonymous adult releasing a gently indented plain flexible bottle, soft overhead light.

rows.text: 嘴邊的醬油若固化、堵住空氣閥，瓶身就可能凹著回不來。
rows.prompt: Medium close-up at a plain kitchen counter, one anonymous adult examining residue near an unmarked flexible bottle spout, gentle side light.

rows.text: 公司說，冷藏時也可能一開蓋就噴出，或冒泡溢出；其他因素也可能帶來這些情況。
rows.prompt: Medium shot at a kitchen counter, one anonymous adult cautiously opening a plain flexible sauce bottle above a small dish with a few small droplets nearby, soft daylight.

rows.text: 對嘴邊的汙損，原廠給的動作是柔軟布沾水、用力擰乾，再擦拭瓶嘴。
rows.prompt: Close-up at a kitchen counter, one anonymous adult wiping the outside of an unmarked sauce spout with a wrung damp cloth, soft overhead light.

texts.c8r10101: 你只想倒一滴醬油，為什麼收回手以前，還得再看一眼瓶嘴？
texts.c8r10102: 一九六一年上市的龜甲萬玻璃桌上瓶，容量是一百五十毫升。
texts.c8r10103: 把它放到小碟前，你握著細頸，傾一下，再扶正，手卻還懸在盤邊。
texts.c8r10527: 回到上市瓶型，二〇一八年，公司在四百五十毫升的新瓶，把主要材料從PE換成PET。
texts.c8r10618: 密封正常時，現行這款瓶的保鮮目安，是開栓後常溫一百二十天。
texts.c8r10621: 剩很少時，可以從上方看，往右轉下整座蓋子，取出餘量。
